# CLOVAMA – Luxury Hair Care E-Commerce Website

CLOVAMA is a responsive multi-page e-commerce website designed for a premium hair care brand. The project focuses on creating a modern shopping experience with an elegant user interface, product catalog, shopping cart functionality, and checkout process.

## Features

* Responsive and modern UI design
* Multi-page website structure
* Product showcase section
* Shopping cart functionality
* Dynamic cart item counter
* Checkout page
* Contact form
* Smooth scrolling effects
* Scroll-based animations
* Local storage support for cart persistence
* Mobile-friendly design

## Pages

### Home Page

* Brand introduction
* Hero section
* Featured products
* Navigation menu

### Products Page

* Product catalog
* Product descriptions
* Pricing information
* Add to Cart functionality

### Shop Page

* Product browsing experience
* Shopping interaction

### About Page

* Brand information
* Company story

### Contact Page

* Contact form
* Business information
* Email and phone details

### Checkout Page

* Order summary
* Customer information form
* Payment method selection

## Tech Stack

### Frontend

* HTML5
* CSS3
* JavaScript (Vanilla JS)

### Browser Storage

* Local Storage API
